mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (oprt_std_id) oprt_std_id AS key,num_val AS number,txt_val AS text FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND oprt_std_id IN ('BUDGET_RATE','SIG_DELAY_WARN','SIG_DELAY_RISK','SIG_COST_WARN','SIG_COST_RISK','SIG_STALE_DAYS') ORDER BY oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym DESC

SELECT p.prj_id,p.prj_nm,c.ptnr_nm AS "custName",p.cntrct_ty_cd, coalesce(d.dev_nm,'PM 미지정') AS "pmName",phase.phs_nm AS "currentPhase", ph.count AS "phaseCount",ph.plan AS plan_prgs_rt,m.actl_prgs_rt AS "memoProgress", m.wrt_dt AS last_memo_dt,p.prfm_bgn_dt,p.cur_cntrct_amt, issues.open_count AS open_issue_count,issues.overdue_count AS overdue_issue_count, issues.high_count AS "highOverdueCount" FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=p.pm_dev_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count, round(least(100,greatest(0,coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN f.plan_bgn_dt IS NULL OR f.plan_end_dt IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN f.plan_end_dt < #{today} THEN f.wght_rt WHEN f.plan_bgn_dt <= #{today} THEN f.wght_rt * (CAST(#{today} AS date)-f.plan_bgn_dt)::numeric / (f.plan_end_dt-f.plan_bgn_dt+1) ELSE 0 END),0))),1) AS plan FROM prj.phs f WHERE f.prj_id=p.prj_id ) ph ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT f.phs_nm FROM prj.phs f WHERE f.prj_id=p.prj_id ORDER BY (f.cmpl_dt IS NOT NULL), CASE WHEN f.cmpl_dt IS NULL THEN f.phs_seq END ASC, CASE WHEN f.cmpl_dt IS NOT NULL THEN f.phs_seq END DESC,f.phs_id LIMIT 1 ) phase ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT w.wrt_dt,w.actl_prgs_rt FROM prj.wkly_memo w WHERE w.prj_id=p.prj_id ORDER BY w.wrt_dt DESC,w.memo_id DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.issue_stts_cd IN ('OPEN','DOING')) AS open_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.issue_stts_cd!='CLOSED' AND i.ddln_dt < #{today}) AS overdue_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.issue_stts_cd!='CLOSED' AND i.ddln_dt < #{today} AND i.svrt_cd='HIGH') AS high_count FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id ) issues ON true WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND (p.prj_stts_cd='RUN' OR (p.prj_stts_cd='PLAN' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today}))) AND p.cntrct_ty_cd=#{type} AND p.bsn_part_id=#{part}
